page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.large is a virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor within the vendor's General Purpose server family. It is provisioned with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core across 2 hardware threads, powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The CPU features 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 33 MB of L3 cache, with support for instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA. Memory capacity is allocated at 16.0 GB, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance includes no bundled local storage, provides no dedicated GPUs, and operates on a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results highlight an asymmetry between single-threaded capabilities and total throughput. Single-core performance falls in the average tier across metrics such as stress-ng single-core (1834.88), Geekbench single-core (1408.0), gzip compression (27.57 GB/sec), and Geekbench text processing (1620.0). Conversely, aggregate multi-threaded and memory throughput metrics place in the bottom 10% to 25%, as reflected by the PassMark CPU score of 2720.23, Geekbench multi-core score of 1624.0, and an uncached large-block memory read bandwidth of 15.21 GB/sec. Application tests similarly reflect these low core counts, logging 1.93 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 2.52 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

From an architecture and cost perspective, the instance delivers a large RAM footprint relative to its limited processing capacity. The trade-off centers on core count versus available memory: while parallel compute capabilities are constrained by the single physical core, memory-hungry workloads that require minimal simultaneous processing can operate without overpaying for excessive vCPUs. Workload fit includes small memory-resident caching layers, staging databases, lightweight background workers, and memory-intensive development environments that do not require heavy concurrent compute or high network throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.large is a general-purpose virtual machine offering 2 vCPUs (1 physical core with 2 threads) on a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon x86_64 processor and 16.0 GB of RAM. The instance lacks local storage, features no GPU accelerators, and maintains a 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations indicate respectable single-threaded performance with an average Geekbench single-core score of 1408.0 and stress-ng score of 1834.88, but multi-threaded and memory throughput metrics sit in the lowest percentiles due to the dual-thread single-core constraint. The high 1:8 vCPU-to-memory allocation makes it an efficient configuration for memory-heavy, low-concurrency tasks such as lightweight in-memory caches, staging database instances, or low-intensity data processing utilities.
